activity_summary: Outside St John's Gate you and John Heminges went over Edmund Tilney's clean signature on fifty leaves of Romeo and Juliet, the seven-shilling fee, your sting at his slight, and his warning to let Richard II alone — confirming Garnish's three leaves stay locked in the chest before you walked on to the Bell.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Still stung by Tilney's dismissal of the lovers' play and alert to his parting warning on Richard II.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Called a clean licence the only kind the company can afford and confirmed Garnish's three leaves stay locked.

entities.name: Edmund Tilney
entities.context: Signed all fifty leaves without a cut and warned to let the other play keep its bounds.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Keeps the three cut leaves of Richard II locked in the chest.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins
entities.context: Carrier at the Bell in Carter Lane where William walks next.

entities.name: Gilbert Shakespeare
entities.context: May already have reached Hobbins's bag at the Bell.

entities.name: Romeo and Juliet
entities.context: Mentioned in Steps outside St John's Gate after Tilney's licence

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in Steps outside St John's Gate after Tilney's licence

facets.activity: Spoke with Heminges outside St John's Gate after the licence

quotes.speaker: John Heminges
quotes.text: A clean licence is the only kind the company can afford. Seven shillings paid once and entered once.

quotes.speaker: William Shakespeare
quotes.text: I have been cut twice and never so slighted.
